description: Wait times for one lane type at every CBP land port on the Mexican border, the Canadian border, or in one state (CA, AZ, NM, TX, WA, MT, ND, MN, MI, NY, VT, ME), sorted by the shortest wait or by name. Closed and pending lanes are listed after posted waits.

lane.description: Lane type: car (general), sentri_nexus, ready_lane, pedestrian, pedestrian_ready, truck or truck_fast. Default car.

state.description: US border state, as a code or a name.

name: border_wait_times_list
title: All border crossing wait times
